tusk-fanduel:greenhouse:7815507.description: THE POSITION Our roster has an opening with your name on it The role of the Sportsbook Brand manager will play a pivotal role in helping to execute our brand across all available touch points. Responsible for delivering creative briefs across integrated campaigns to bring to life messages that will be compelling to our target audience. This role will work alongside all marketing teams to ensure high quality execution upholding our brand proposition. The ideal candidate has experience working on high quality brands in competitive markets, can contribute to the building of communications platforms, and relishes working with a range of stakeholders. Reporting into the Brand Marketing function, this is an impactful role that will help deliver the long-term strategic direction of our marketing in our drive to become America’s next iconic sports & gaming brand. In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs. THE GAME PLAN Everyone on our team has a part to play · Serve as the captain of our Sportsbook marketing execution, coordinating deliverables cross-functionally so everyone knows their role and when actions are deliverable by. · Understand our main marketing objectives and helps shape approach alongside other teams to go after key moments that matter in our marketing plans specifically focused on our Sportsbook led customer. · Produce high quality creative briefs & signs off on creative execution across integrated campaigns. · Manage our creative agency day-to-day, ensuring alignment between our Sportsbook brand and creative concepts · Understand our Sportsbook target audience and looks for opportunities to leverage priority brand RTBs (reason-to-believe) especially within key tentpole sporting moments · Understand media planning and can effectively work with our media teams to bring our Sportsbook messaging to life within key placements. · Ensure effective communication of plans – especially when leading integrated planning and across key areas of responsibility. · Ensure effective briefing processes are in place for delivery with excellence and co-ordinates optimization of our creative delivery process with our creative operations teams. · Review competitor advertising communication, looking for opportunities to optimize the delivery of our proposition in market. · Build the internal brand of Sportsbook – creates a drum beat of company-wide internal comms opportunities. · Be a customer advocate in all marketing campaigns, ensuring that the brand and our consumers are at the heart of our created communications. THE STATS What we're looking for in our next teammate · 5+ years of experience in brand, communications or marketing – ideally with category experience in sports, gaming, and technology. · Experience working on both new and existing brands in competitive markets. · Experience applying traditional brand building skills in a growth & performance-oriented digital business. · Ability to critically evaluate creative execution to ensure it delivers on our objectives · Ability to deliver creative feedback effectively and synthesize collective feedback coming from various stakeholders. · Ability to steer creative feedback process involving cross-functional partners. · Ability to work with a wider variety of stakeholders to understand problems and help solve them with action · Understands data – whether that’s business or brand health data to give the context on why we need to prioritize activity. · Enjoys the pace of a growing business, can work fast when required but is also able to step back and work strategically. · High quality interpersonal and presentation skills – people enjoy working with you, and you inspire with your passion for the brand. · Knowledge of sports and/or experience working within a heavily regulated industry is a plus ·

verdane-inriver:teamtailor:4d47cb98-5ecc.description: At Inriver, we help brands deliver better product experiences - everywhere their customers are. From the first product detail to the final purchase decision, we make product information work smarter. Now we’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead and grow one of our most important product areas: Integrations . This domain covers both adapters (inbound and outbound connectors with third party systems) and syndication (outbound retail endpoint connectors and the Inriver Syndicate application). If you enjoy shaping strategy, leading product teams, and working cross-functionally to solve real customer problems - you might feel right at home here. This is a high-leverage, visible role with a direct line to revenue, ecosystem growth, and customer satisfaction. Why you’ll love this role 💙 As our next Group Product Manager, you’ll step into a role with real influence and impact: Own the product direction for our Integrations area and shape what we build next Lead and support Product Managers and help the team succeed together Work closely with Engineering, Design, Customer Success, and Sales to turn customer needs into product outcomes Be part of a company with strong product ambitions and a friendly, down-to-earth culture What you’ll do 💭 You’ll lead the product strategy and execution for Integrations, ensuring we build the right things — in the right way — at the right time. Set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Integrations product area Drive prioritization based on customer value, business impact, and product goals Partner with Engineering and Design to deliver outcomes through strong discovery and delivery Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to align expectations and move forward together Support and coach Product Managers, helping them grow and thrive Improve time-to-market for adapters and syndication endpoints Own KPIs for integrations and syndication Represent product internally and externally Keep a close eye on customer needs, market trends, and how integrations can unlock new value What you’ll bring We don’t expect you to tick every box - but we think you’ll succeed here if you have many of the below: ✔️ Experience in product leadership (ideally leading a product area, product managers, or cross-functional teams) ✔️Strong product skills: strategy, discovery, prioritization, and execution ✔️Comfort working with technical topics such as APIs, integrations, platforms, or ecosystems ✔️ The ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders ✔️ A collaborative mindset — you bring structure, calm, and momentum ✔️ Curiosity and a drive to improve how things work (not just what gets built) Why Inriver At Inriver, you’ll join a global company with a product at the center - and people who genuinely care about building something meaningful together. Here you’ll get: The opportunity to shape a key product area with high visibility and impact A supportive team culture with space to learn, lead, and grow A workplace where your voice matters - and your work makes a difference We’re serious about building great products - and we also care about enjoying the ride. In our Malmö office, you’ll find things like: Tuesday Fika☕ Friday breakfasts to start the day together A running club and social activities for anyone who wants to join A welcoming mix of focused work, collaboration, and a few laughs along the way We work in a hybrid setup, with flexibility and trust as a baseline. Ready to apply? 📬 We’d love to hear from you. If you’re curious but not 100% sure, we still encourage you to apply. We’re happy to explore the fit together!
